info.title: API.SH: Grailed
info.description: The Grailed API from API.SH: public Grailed data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
Search Grailed listings (menswear and womenswear resale) with every filter of the shop: keywords, department, category, subcategory, size, designer (name or id), condition, color, seller location, market (strata), badge and price range, in eight sort orders. `sold=true` searches sold listings instead and returns each one's sold price and sold date (sorts: recently sold, price low or high). Each listing: id, title, link, designers, price (USD), sold price and date, size, condition, department, category, color, styles, location, buy now and offer flags, price drops, follower count, badges, cover image, dates and the seller's public username, rating and transaction count, plus `raw`. Also returns the facet values with counts for the search. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page (the site shows the first 1,000 results of a search).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/grailed-search

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Keywords (designer, item, model). Optional when a filter is set.

parameters.name: sold
parameters.description: true searches sold listings (sold price and date in each item).

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Order: default (recently listed or bumped), relevance, newest, popular, trending, most_followed, price_asc, price_desc. With sold=true: default/recently_sold, price_asc, price_desc.

parameters.name: department
parameters.description: Department.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Top category, e.g. tops, bottoms, outerwear, footwear, tailoring, accessories (comma list = any of). Values in `facets.category`.

parameters.name: subcategory
parameters.description: Category path, e.g. footwear.hitop_sneakers or tops.sweatshirts_hoodies (comma list). Values in `facets.category_path` or /grailed/v1/categories.

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: Category size, e.g. tops.m, bottoms.32, footwear.10 (comma list). Values in `facets.category_size`.

parameters.name: designer
parameters.description: Designer name as Grailed spells it, e.g. Rick Owens (comma list). Values in `facets["designers.name"]`.

parameters.name: designer_id
parameters.description: Designer id, e.g. 32 (comma list), from /grailed/v1/designers.

parameters.name: condition
parameters.description: is_new, is_gently_used, is_used, is_worn, is_not_specified (comma list).

parameters.name: color
parameters.description: Color, e.g. black, blue (comma list).

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: Seller location: United States, Europe, Asia, Canada, United Kingdom, Australia/NZ, Other (comma list).

parameters.name: strata
parameters.description: Market: grailed, hype, sartorial, basic (comma list).

parameters.name: badge
parameters.description: Badge, e.g. staff_pick.

parameters.name: price_min
parameters.description: Lowest price in USD.

parameters.name: price_max
parameters.description: Highest price in USD.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Results per page, 1-100 (default 40).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (default 1).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
A Grailed seller's public profile: id, username, avatar, location and country, member since, transactions, rating average and count, sold and purchase counts, review tags, listings for sale, followers, following, trusted, verified, quick responder and speedy shipper badges, vacation flag, plus the first listings for sale and the latest reviews. `profile_complete` is false when the seller has nothing for sale (the stats then come only from the reviews).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/grailed-seller

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
